title: 8 Best Liège Waffles in Liège
description: The best Liège waffles in Liège, Belgium — curated from Reddit reviews and locals. Pearl sugar, caramelized crust, gaufres fourrées & certified authentic producers. Interactive map included.

places.name: Pollux

redditQuotes.text: Pollux is THE place for gaufres de Liège in Liège. It's at Place de la Cathédrale — classic spot, locals go there, perfect waffle.
Pollux on Place de la Cathédrale sells delicious waffles — classic à la vanille or à la cannelle, but especially the fourrées au chocolat!
redditQuotes.source: — Femmes d'Aujourd'hui / local food guide · reviewed 2024

places.verdict: Pollux is what every Reddit thread about Liège waffles eventually mentions.

comparison.why it made the list: Pollux is what every Reddit thread about Liège waffles eventually mentions. This little sandwich bar and waffle stand on Place de la Cathédrale — right in front of the cathedral — has been feeding locals and visitors for decades. The gaufre fourrée (waffle filled with chocolate or vanilla before baking) is their signature and worth the detour alone. Recommended by Lonely Planet, TasteAtlas, and practically every Belgian food guide.
comparison.what to order: Pollux, an iconic spot at Place de la Cathédrale, 4000 Liège, with a 3.6-star rating from 633 reviews, is known for its classic gaufre liégeoise. Order the plain, warm waffle to experience the caramelized pearl sugar at its best. Alternatively, try the gaufre fourrée (filled waffle) with vanilla cream or dark chocolate filling tucked inside the dough before baking — a Pollux signature.

places.name: Une Gaufrette Saperlipopette

redditQuotes.text: Saperlipopette is exactly what you want — grandma-style waffles, no shortcuts, no additives. Everything is made with local ingredients. One of only a handful of shops with the official 'Authentique Gaufre de Liège' label.
Best waffle of Belgium. Authentic Liège waffles, freshly baked — additive-free, made with local ingredients.

places.verdict: Founded in 2013, Saperlipopette quickly became one of Liège's most respected waffle producers — and it earned the official "Authentique Gaufre de Liège" certification to prove it.

comparison.why it made the list: Founded in 2013, Saperlipopette quickly became one of Liège's most respected waffle producers — and it earned the official "Authentique Gaufre de Liège" certification to prove it. Three locations now: the waffle boutique (Rue des Mineurs), a boulangerie, and a crème glacée shop. The motto is Marcus Aurelius: "Sweetness is invincible." In this case, it's hard to argue.
comparison.what to order: Une Gaufrette Saperlipopette, a certified authentic waffle shop at Rue des Mineurs 7, 4000 Liège, uses grandmother's recipe with additive-free flour. Order the plain gaufre liégeoise, made to grandmother's recipe with additive-free flour from Moulins Bodson (a local Hesbaye mill). Seasonal specials vary; their chouquettes and pastries pair beautifully with a waffle. The La Petite Boutique location is the waffle shop; La Boulangerie is the bakery.

redditQuotes.text: Eggenols is one of the oldest and most respected patisseries in Liège for the gaufre au sucre. It's not flashy — it's just really, really good.
The authentic Liège waffle is often called 'gaufre au sucre' in Liège itself, not 'gaufre liégeoise' — look for it at Eggenols.

places.verdict: Eggenols is the kind of patisserie that doesn't need Instagram to exist — it's been making waffles for generations, and locals know exactly where to find it.

Sunday mornings here, waffle in hand, watching the market sprawl along the Meuse — that's the Liège experience in miniature.
comparison.what to order: Le Matin Liégeois, a certified authentic spot at Place du Marché 20, 4000 Liège, with a 3.8-star rating from 169 reviews, is best known for its morning gaufre.
